style: High-quality 3D animated feature film still, close to photoreal (modern big-studio animation look), rich detail, cinematic lighting and depth of field. Vertical 9:16, keep the top third fairly simple and dark-to-plain (text sits there), the action in the lower two thirds. Ancient Arabian desert mountains. The men are ordinary travellers in simple earth-toned robes and head wraps, with beards.

scenes.s1: Inside a rocky mountain cave looking out at the entrance: a huge boulder has just rolled down and is sealing the opening, dust and small stones falling, the last sliver of evening light vanishing. Dramatic. No people visible.
scenes.s2: Three ordinary travellers sitting close together in a dark rocky cave, lit only by faint blue light, worried, looking toward a giant boulder that blocks the entrance. Medium-wide shot.
scenes.s3: Three ordinary travellers in a dark cave raising their open hands in prayer (dua), heads lowered, faint warm light on their hands, the giant boulder behind them. Medium-wide shot, seen from the side.
scenes.s4: A simple old mud-brick home at night, an oil lamp glowing, an elderly couple asleep on mats seen from a distance, and a man standing quietly by the door holding a wooden bowl of milk, waiting patiently, the sky outside turning blue before dawn. Wide shot, warm and tender.
scenes.s5: One ordinary traveller in a dark cave, kneeling with his open hands raised in dua, eyes closed, tears, faint light on his hands. Medium shot from the side, not a close-up.
scenes.s6: Inside a dark cave: the giant boulder at the entrance has shifted slightly, a thin bright crack of daylight shining in, dust floating in the beam. Hopeful. No people.
scenes.s7: An ordinary man at night in an ancient Arabian town street, turning away and walking off from a closed doorway, his head lowered in fear of Allah, moonlight, alone. Wide shot from behind.
scenes.s8: Inside a dark cave: the giant boulder has moved further, a wider shaft of golden daylight streaming in across the stone floor, but the gap is still too narrow to pass. Three travellers in silhouette watching. Wide shot.
scenes.s9: A large herd of camels, cows and sheep grazing in a green valley between desert mountains, and one ordinary shepherd worker in a simple robe standing among them looking amazed. Bright warm morning. Wide shot.
scenes.s10: The giant boulder rolling away from a cave mouth in a burst of golden sunrise light, dust in the air, three ordinary travellers stepping out into the light, seen from behind. Epic, hopeful.
scenes.s11: Three ordinary travellers walking away along a desert mountain path into a glowing sunrise, seen from behind, long shadows, peaceful, a vast open sky.
